meta.parties: Sherman De Silva & Co., Ltd. v. De Silva

rules.statement: An amendment to a plaint must be considered without reference to the ultimate result of the case and quite apart from it. The fundamental character of the suit, not its prayer, determines whether an amendment alters the nature and scope of the action.
